decisions.reason: As a recently launched, core-adjacent automation offering for industrial heat exchangers, it still has option value and likely needs more market learning before a medium German machinery firm would exit.

The web-based weir-dimensioning tool is more peripheral to the firm's machinery business, but its likely low carrying cost makes it worth keeping on the market a bit longer while demand and lead-generation value remain uncertain.

A fouling detection system fits closely with engineering equipment and service capabilities, so with only one year of evidence the firm would usually preserve this option unless clearer negative signals emerge.
